name: Halloween Bonanza

features.name: Pay-anywhere refills
features.description: Win by symbol count; the reels refill after each win.

features.name: Summed multipliers
features.description: Multiple multiplier symbols in one spin are added together.

review:
Halloween Bonanza dresses BGaming's refilling-reels engine in spooky costumes. It's a pay-anywhere game, so wins are counted by how many identical symbols are on the screen.

Four scatters award 10 free spins, five award 20 and six award 30. In the bonus, multiplier symbols take a random value from 2x to 100x, and if several land in one spin, their values are added and applied to that spin's win. Three or more scatters during the round add more spins. Chance x2 and a bonus buy are available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 10,197x maximum, and the RTP is 96.11%. Free spins are rare, roughly once every 398 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 398 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
